fees.tier: Tier 1 (public, conservative primary; account tier not verified)
fees.not_used: Spot rebate table (0.38 % maker) applies only to listed pairs

costs.terminal_unwind: mid and decision-window spread known at or before window end; taker; no fill window beyond the end

h2a.feature: FL30 = mean f(p), p in [t-720h, t-1h], min 648 known
h2a.label: Y(s,h) = mean f(p), p in [s, s+h-1h], min 0.90*h known, known at s+h
h2a.model: pooled OLS Y = a(h) + b(h) * X, equal weights
h2a.window: expanding from S0, samples with s+h <= t
h2a.s0_rule: first daily date with X available for >= 10 assets
h2a.predict_clip: X clipped to the fit's winsor cut-offs

h2b.order: winsorize (0.01, 0.99) then z-score on the fit sample
h2b.missing_feature: sample dropped from fit; no forecast for the asset

h2_gate.missing_label_rule: T: min(0,F); B: max(0,F); H1 T: min(0,F)
h2_gate.slope_sample: eligible (i,s) on non-skipped dates with >= 50 % of label periods known
h2_gate.bootstrap_pairing: R and c on the same date-block resamples

h3.cov_shrinkage: Ledoit-Wolf 2004 constant-correlation, analytic intensity clipped to [0,1]
h3.side_split: risk parity on basket vols, then dollar cap 0.2, then standalone side ratio <= 1.5 (shrink the larger-risk side; INFEASIBLE if net dollar > 0.2 of gross)
h3.drop_rule: drop the smallest |n| below max(min_qty*mid, 10 USD) (ties by name), recompute from scratch, at most #legs iterations
h3.intraday_post_exit_check: next 15m tick: post-rounding checks on the realised book; proportional reduce-only scale-down; else infeasible
h3.ewma_init: sample variance of the first 30 days

h1.qty_rule: floor(N/px) to max(spot step, perp step); both legs >= their minimums
h1.forward_marketable_rule: first ticker after t with ask <= limit -> taker by walking depth
h1.forward_risk_exits: taker at the first snapshot (both legs); only the 00:00 economic exit is maker-first
h1.feas_membership: H1, no INVALID RUN/MODEL INVALID, P10=0, PRIMARY (P1<=0 or P3<=0), MAKER-BOUND (P1>0, P3>0, P5, P6)
h1.feasibility_mb_formula: sum_e(fee+spreadslip-lagPnL)/sum_e entry notional; open episodes at day 90 exit by hypothetical taker unwind
h1.confirmation_start: day 91, flat, 265 USD, no state carried

statistics.bootstrap: moving block, one-sided H0 mean <= 0, V5 stats.mbb
statistics.p_go: max(p_net, p_carry), each the max over blocks
statistics.forward_family: all 4 holdout configs, m_F = 4, fixed; non-candidates p = 1
statistics.interim_extra_test: Newey-West lag 28 one-sided t-test, net and carry, p <= the config's Holm threshold

criteria.active_day_rule: >= 12 h with gross >= 10% of equity (H1 gross = hedged perp notional)
criteria.p9_split: first two subwindows floor(n/3) days, the rest to the last

forward.evidence_start: T_F = time of the v6-code-frozen tag; recv_ts >= T_F; day 1 = first 00:00 UTC at or after T_F
forward.pnl_masked_until: holdout decision and then each scheduled look
forward.model_inputs_before_T_F: funding, mark, index from before T_F (incl. the holdout window) as inputs only, and only after the single holdout opening
forward.missing_funding: official Kraken historical funding API, downloaded after the period and hashed; never interpolated; unavailable -> INVALID RUN for that look

holdout.guard_window: [2026-07-01, T_F) refused without the holdout token

references_holdout: V5 W and E unchanged; verdict-free
